question: What would changing billing affect?
answer:
Changing sample_app.billing could affect 2 other modules: sample_app.api, sample_app.main.
The proof, one import link at a time (2 links):
- sample_app.api imports sample_app.billing (sample_app/api.py, line 4)
- sample_app.main imports sample_app.api (sample_app/main.py, line 3)
scope: Scope: reads the Python imports of sample_app statically, at module level, and changes nothing. Dynamic imports, reflection, generated code and other languages are not followed. Full list: run.py --capabilities.
